title: Don't Die With Cash In GTA 6
yt_title: GTA 6: Stop Carrying Cash Or You'll Lose It 💸 #shorts
description:
In GTA 6, cash you carry is different from money in the bank, and you can lose cash if you die or get arrested. Stash or deposit it often.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6Tips

lines.text: Stop walking around GTA 6 with a pocket full of cash.
Cash in your pocket is not the same as money in the bank.
Die or get arrested, and you can lose the cash you carry.
So after every job, stash it at a safehouse or deposit it.
Big loot works the same way, steal it, fence it, then bank the cash.
Bank first, then go cause chaos.
How much cash have you lost already?
